source: Initialized by scripts/cfb_model_receipts.py; no forecast rows existed at initialization.
note: EMPTY BY DESIGN. No CFB forecast has yet been frozen before kickoff. This file publishes the append-only prospective receipt contract without manufacturing a backtest row or implying that the 2025 completed season was forecast live.

integrity.algorithm: SHA-256 of canonical receipt JSON rows joined by LF in append order.

contract.immutability: Existing rows may never be removed, reordered or changed.
contract.grading: Outcomes and scores belong in a separate derived grading surface.

tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
